summary: SENDBID Phase 1 backend testing — 37/37 pytest tests PASS (100%). Covered all auth flows (register+OTP, login, biometric, PIN create, forgot/reset password), wallet (get, transactions, recharge QR, withdraw QR with PIN, P2P with PIN), transfers (FX rate, draft, confirm with 10-digit withdrawal_code + HMAC QR ~48h, list, detail, bids, receipt PDF), WebSocket /api/ws/auction/{id} snapshot event, accept-bid + chat (open AGENT_ASSIGNED → closed COMPLETED) + complete-mock, beneficiaries (seeded 3 + create/delete), payment methods CRUD, KYC tier1+tier2 mock flow, notifications (list/read/read-all), profile PATCH + change-password, referral, loyalty, scheduled transfers CRUD, disputes, documents, support FAQ + contact, countries, and PIN brute-force lockout (5 fails → 423).
action_items: Phase 1 backend: ALL endpoints functional. Safe to proceed to Phase 2 (frontend testing).

Optional hardening (non-blocking): tighten CORS allow_origins=['*'] to specific origins in production; add rate limiting on /auth/login, /auth/register, /auth/forgot-password; add password strength validation in register/reset-password.
Note for production: dev_email_otp/dev_phone_otp/dev_reset_token are returned in responses as designed for DEV mode — must be hidden behind an env flag before prod (currently always returned).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 1313 lines — consider splitting into routers (auth.py, wallet.py, transfers.py, kyc.py, etc.) for maintainability.
No DB transaction around P2P balance updates (debit + credit are non-atomic). Acceptable for demo, must be addressed before real money handling.
WebSocket /api/ws/auction/{id} has no auth — any client can subscribe by knowing the transfer_id. OK for demo, add token auth before prod.
Auction emits at most 8 bids (sample = min(8, len(agents))) even though spec mentions 5 rounds × 50 agents. Aligned with mock spirit but worth confirming with PM.
create_pin enforces 6 digits but does NOT block weak PINs (000000, 123456, 111111). Same for change-password (no min length).
_id is properly excluded everywhere (clean_doc + projection). Good.
seed_data_creation: No additional seed needed. Backend auto-seeds demo client (client@sendbid.app), admin, 3 beneficiaries, 2 payment methods, 20 agents, 2 notifications, 3 wallet tx on startup. Tests create transient TEST_-prefixed users/beneficiaries/payment-methods.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All backend endpoints validated end-to-end via public EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL. Demo client login: client@sendbid.app / Client@123! / PIN 123456 / wallet 1250.50 EUR. Confirmed: 10-digit withdrawal_code, HMAC-SHA256 QR with ~48h expiry, WebSocket auction snapshot event, chat opens on AGENT_ASSIGNED & closes on COMPLETED, PIN lockout after 5 wrong attempts → HTTP 423. Frontend (Expo web) is bundling correctly; ngrok tunnel error in expo.err.log is non-blocking — web preview at https://mobile-transfer-hub-3.preview.emergentagent.com works.
